review: Personally read the whole page, both halves, all lines against both witnesses, and enlarged every block, cancellation, insertion and critical formula. Broad crops were viewed at 2×; doubts and differing details at 4–5×. The entire left margin was rotated clockwise 90° and enlarged 3×, including its smaller final note; a second detail was viewed at 5×. Coordinates below refer to the original 1732×2235 image. Crops that accidentally missed a target were replaced and are not relied on. No context was opened.
